description: This file contains unit tests for the DynamoDB implementation of Orleans reminder tables, specifically testing storing and retrieving grain reminders. It uses Xunit for testing and references AWS SDK components and Orleans infrastructure.

classes.name: DynamoDBRemindersTableTests
classes.description: A test class for DynamoDB reminder table implementation, testing initialization, range retrieval, parallel upsert, and simple reminder retrieval within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: CreateRemindersTable
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of DynamoDBReminderTable after checking DynamoDB availability.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Returns the connection string for DynamoDB service if available.

methods.name: RemindersTable_AWS_Init
methods.description: Test initialization of DynamoDB reminders table (skippable).

methods.name: RemindersTable_AWS_RemindersRange
methods.description: Test retrieving a range of reminders asynchronously.
